description: This file contains unit tests for the InstancesStore class, specifically testing the decoding of presence event payloads via JSON encoding. It defines a test struct with a test method that constructs a payload, processes it through the store, and verifies that the store's instances are correctly populated.

classes.name: InstancesStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing a test case for verifying JSON decoding of presence event payloads into the InstancesStore.

methods.name: `presence event payload decodes via JSON encoder`
methods.description: A test method that constructs a payload matching the expected shape of a presence event, encodes it, feeds it into the InstancesStore, and asserts that the instances are correctly populated.
